tours.description: End-to-end guide to recording a General Ledger budget in Odoo: build one Budgetary Position for revenue type accounts and one for expense type accounts, then create the budget with a planned amount per position, save, confirm and review it in Budgets Analysis. Worked example uses FY2028 with hypothetical figures.

description_i18n.en_US: End-to-end guide to recording a General Ledger budget in Odoo: build one Budgetary Position for revenue type accounts and one for expense type accounts, then create the budget with a planned amount per position, save, confirm and review it in Budgets Analysis. Worked example uses FY2028 with hypothetical figures.
